payload.body: Epic complete. FR-105 (cross-region bus federation: docs/multi-region.md design + FrickRegionBus/FederatingClusterBus seam + MemoryRegionFabric), FR-106 (per-region-primary write routing: RegionWriteRouter + static/claim ownership, home-region-authoritative convergence), FR-107 (region-aware failover: deterministic lowest-regionId promotion + docs/multi-region-operations.md LB/DNS runbook). All merged green; production WAN transport adapter is the documented next step.
